Through: Mr. Ajay Vikram Singh, A  State with W/SI Neelsee,
 Mahal  Ms. Aishwarya Rao, Adv. 
 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE JASMEET SINGH  ORDER % 21.03.2023 1.
This is an application seeking bail in FIR No. 162/2019 registered u/s 376/384/506 IPC registered at PS Chandni Mahal, Delhi.

2. As per the FIR, the applicant had taken photographs of the complainant while she was bathing and had blackmailed her based on the said photographs and forcibly established physical relationship with her.
Thereafter, he also threatened her and took money from her.
Hence the FIR.
3. The applicant has been in custody since 13.10.2019.
The statement of the prosecutrix has been recorded.
4. Ms. Rao, learned counsel for the complainant states that the applicant has photographs of the complainant which can be misused.
5. The applicant has stated in the bail application that it was a consensual relationship.
These are issues which can only be adjudicated once the complete trial takes place.
6. As regards the issue of photographs being misused, these apprehensions can be addressed by imposing appropriate conditions.

sentences.text: 7. As of today, the applicant is an undertrial prisoner and has been incarcerated for more than 3 years.
8. For the reason that the applicant has been in custody for more than 3 years, the statement of the prosecutrix is over, I am inclined to allow the application.

9. The applicant is directed to be released on bail on the following terms and conditions:
i.

The applicant shall furnish a personal bond and a surety bond in the sum of Rs.
15,000/- each, to the satisfaction of the Trial Court; ii. The applicant or his family,
relative, friend shall not upload or circulate any photographs of the prosecutrix which he may have on any social media platform.
iii. The applicant shall appear before the Court as and when the matter is taken up for hearing;

iv. The applicant shall join investigation as and when called by the I.O concerned;
v.

The applicant shall provide his mobile number to the Investigating Officer (IO)
concerned, which shall be kept in working condition at all times.

The applicant shall report to the local Police Station on the first Monday of every month;
vii.
The applicant shall not be in the vicinity of the prosecutrix and/or shall not contact with any of her family members; viii.

The applicant shall share his live location through Google Pin location to the I.O. concerned;
ix.

In case the applicant changes his address, he will inform the IO concerned and this Court also;
x.

The applicant shall not leave the country during the bail period and surrender his passport, if any, at the time of release before the I.O. concerned;
xi.

The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity during the bail period;
xii.

The applicant shall not communicate with, or come into contact with any of the prosecution witnesses, or any member of the victim's family, or tamper with the evidence of the case.
10.
In case any of the above conditions are violated, the complainant shall be at liberty to file an application seeking cancellation of bail.
